# Topicals
\n Topicals are most people's first choice for treating wounds on the field... But their use is much more limited in the Threshold.
## Basic Topicals
[bold]Bruise Packs[/bold] and [bold]Ointment[/bold] only work when the [color=crimson]Total Damage[/color] is [color=burlywood]at most [color=khaki]40[/color][/color]. \n A [bold]Roll of Gauze[/bold] will only heal a very small amount of [color=lightpink]Slash[/color] and [color=lightpink]Pierce[/color] but will [color=burlywood]stop bleeding[/color] and can be applied independently of the [color=crimson]Total Damage[/color]. \n
## Advanced Topicals
[bold]Medicated Sutures[/bold] and [bold]Regenerative Mesh[/bold] will only work when the [color=crimson]Total Damage[/color] is [color=burlywood]at least [color=khaki]90[/color][/color]. \n [bold]Necrospray[/bold] can be used to heal both [color=lightcoral]Brute[/color] and [color=lightcoral]Burn[/color] so long as the [color=crimson]Total Damage[/color] is [color=burlywood]at least [color=khaki]180[/color][/color], it is mostly meant for dead people. \n
